required_outcomes: Reads the thumbs-up as the provider agreeing to the Friday clean, because it answers a yes/no question about a date (unlike an emoji in reply to a request for a quote).

Confirms the booking to the provider in writing with the explicit date, Friday 14 November 2025, after the check-out works finish on Sunday 9 November, and asks them to say at once if that is not what they meant.
Sorts out or asks about access to the empty flat (for example collecting keys from the office), since there is no tenant to let the cleaner in.
acceptable_alternatives: Asking the provider for a one-word confirmation of Friday 14 November, provided the message also covers access and the visit is pencilled in.
Recording the visit on the case for 14 November with access by agency key.
positive_behaviours: Notes that the landlord approved the £90 quote at event 012, so no further approval is needed.
Puts the case on hold or sets a follow-up after the visit date to check the clean was done and get the invoice.
Mentions confirming the check-out works are finished before the clean, given the clean depends on them.
red_flags: Escalating or asking the landlord anything because of the emoji.
Writing 'Friday' without the date when the agency's own email was sent on a Friday.
prohibited_actions: Treating the job as done or recording an invoice.
Telling the landlord the clean has been completed or is guaranteed before it happens.
critical_failures: Leaving the reply unanswered with no booking confirmed or recorded, so the clean is not arranged.
